title: Equestrian centre fire-water supply and dry hydrant (Council Order 0015435)
jurisdiction: Alberta; accredited municipality not named in the order

facts.text: The building was described as a non-sprinklered Group A Division 3 equestrian centre, up to two storeys; the order concerned firefighting water supply.
The record listed a 2008 building-permit application, permit, building-code analysis, inspection reports and engineering drawings for the dry-hydrant installation.
The order required a dry hydrant within 90 metres and an interim fire watch under an AHJ-approved fire-safety plan.
